# v4 and v6 trades, 2024-01-01 to 2026-11-01 (spent window, descriptive only)

Net P/L includes 0.12% cost per side. v4 trades use the whole account. In v6 each trade is one
sub-signal on one coin, so it uses 1/8 of the account (1/2 coin x 1/4 sub-signal).
Portfolio impact is the trade's P/L times its account share; it ignores compounding.
